verdict.rationale: The IPO's patent filing path says the sign-in step is a GOV.UK One Login credential account that you can set up yourself online, which points to a remotely completable credential login rather than an in-person or postal step. The pack never describes the MFA factors, and never rules out biometric liveness or identity checks inside One Login, so the core claim is only half evidenced. Missing for 10: documentation of the MFA method (e.g. authenticator app or SMS code), explicit confirmation that no biometric liveness or document check is required, and coverage of sign-in for trade mark services.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail

citations.quote: The identity wall on the patent filing path is a credential account, stated before you start
You'll need your One Login details if you have them, or you can set them up. File online
